::: {#exm-digits-racket}
#### Counting digits in Racket

The recursive definition of $d$ in @exm-digit-count becomes a Racket function line by line:

```racket
(define (digits n)
  (if (< n 10)
      1
      (+ 1 (digits (quotient n 10)))))
```

Following @rem-racket-recursion:

- the base case answers 1 for every input less than 10;
- the recursive call is `(digits (quotient n 10))`, on $\floor{n / 10}$, which is less than $n$;
- the combination adds 1 to the result of the recursive call.

`(digits 2026)` calls `(digits 202)`, `(digits 20)` and `(digits 2)` in turn, as in @exm-digit-count,
and returns 4.

:::
